name: gmail_search_mail
intent: Search Gmail mail for a term and report the first result's subject
description: Searches Gmail for a given term or sender and opens the first matching conversation to report its subject line.
patterns: search my mail for a term
find an email and tell me the subject of the first result
search Gmail and report the first matching subject
what is the subject of the first email about this

inputs.name: search_query
inputs.description: Search term to look for in Gmail

steps.intent: Type {{search_query}} into the Search in mail field and submit the search
Tap the first search result for {{search_query}} to open it and read its subject

outputs.name: first_result_subject
outputs.example: Hey, you made it .. Here’s 40% off
